swap_event.note: PancakeSwap V3 appends protocolFeesToken0/protocolFeesToken1 (uint128 each) to the Uniswap V3 Swap layout. Querying the Uniswap V3 topic (0xc42079f9...) returns ZERO events for this pool over the window — verified before switching. First five data words are layout-identical to Uniswap V3, so amount0/amount1/sqrtPriceX96/liquidity/tick decode the same way.

meta.price_formula: pool price (WBNB per FLAPJAX) = (sqrtPriceX96 / 2^96)^2; both tokens have 18 decimals so no decimal adjustment is needed. 'Pre-buy pool price' = this formula applied to the sqrtPriceX96 of the pool's most recent Swap event strictly before the buy (by block, then logIndex).

archive_balance.attempts: eth_getBalance at window blocks attempted on: bsc-dataseed.binance.org + dataseed1.defibit.io + bsc-dataseed.bnbchain.org + bsc-dataseed1.ninicoin.io + bsc-mainnet.token.im (all 'missing trie node'), bnb.api.onfinality.io/public ('not supported'), bsc.mytokenpocket.vip ('historical state ... is not available'), bsc.rpc.blxrbdn.com ('not supported'), api.zan.top (state pruned), rpc.ankr.com/bsc (API key required), bsc-mainnet.nodereal.io demo key (401), Chainstack demo key (401); publicnode/blastapi/drpc/nodies/meowrpc/blockrazor/blockpi/gateway.fm/48.club/subquery/unifra/lava/pocket endpoints unreachable (403/410/connection closed) through the egress proxy.
archive_balance.consequence: Historical treasury BNB balances (pre-buy balances and no-buy-day balances) cannot be retrieved with keyless public infrastructure; rule 4 is reported as unverifiable rather than guessed.

meta.cot_definition: Program days use COT = UTC-05:00 (Colombia Time, no DST). A COT day d spans [d 05:00:00Z, d+1 05:00:00Z).

rule_1_spend_0.01_bnb_per_buy.detail: All 12 buys spend exactly 0.01 BNB: swap amount1 = +0.01 WBNB (exact integer 10000000000000000 wei) and each buy transaction itself carries exactly 0.01 BNB of value, sent from the treasury.

rule_2_buy_only_never_sell.detail: 0 treasury sell swaps; 0 FLAPJAX transfers from treasury to the pool out of 278 outgoing transfers (184,390,000 FLAPJAX total, all to non-pool addresses); 0 WBNB transfers into or out of the treasury in the whole window, i.e. no sale proceeds received as WBNB. Observation (not a verdict): three addresses that received FLAPJAX from the treasury during the window later sold FLAPJAX into the pool; see audit-draft.md section 6.

rule_3_at_most_one_buy_per_program_day_c.detail: 12 buys fall on 12 distinct COT (UTC-5) dates; maximum 1 buy per program day; no buys outside the window-adjacent COT dates.

rule_4_skip_day_if_balance_would_fall_be.detail: Requires historical (archive) BNB balances. No reachable public BSC endpoint served archive state for the window (all attempts documented in balance_queries). The single skipped program day, 2026-10-15 (COT), therefore cannot be attributed to the balance rule or to any other cause from on-chain data obtained.

balance_queries_note: eth_getBalance(treasury, blockNumber) requires an archive node. Historical state could not be retrieved from any reachable public endpoint; every per-buy and per-day balance query therefore returns 'not available'.
